the seed rolls over at UTC midnight. - Reuse the practice worker path (`core.ts`) unchanged, including earning claims (the seed is a normal practice seed) and the catalog-version check on saves. - Document it as a practice setup option in the spec's practice section (§9.9), not as a mode: queue, ranked and records are untouched. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/practice/` (`PracticeSetup.tsx`, `core.ts`, `protocol.ts`);
